title: fix(hub): turn on sign-in rate limiting regardless of NODE_ENV
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

- Sets `rateLimit: { enabled: true }` in the hub's better-auth config; better-auth otherwise enables it only when `NODE_ENV=production`. Uses the default in-memory store.
- Server tests give each signed-up member its own `x-forwarded-for` so sign-up limits apply per member.

Verified: new server test gets 401, 401, 401, 429 for repeated sign-in from one client while another client still gets 401; it fails without the fix. `bun run check` and `bun run test` (691 pass) pass.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(hub): turn on sign-in rate limiting regardless of NODE_ENV

files.patch:
@@ -41,6 +41,8 @@ export function createHubAuth(db: DB["db"], config: HubAuthConfig) {
     trustedOrigins: config.trustedOrigins,
     database: drizzleAdapter(db, { provider: "pg" }),
     emailAndPassword: { enabled: authMethods(config).emailPassword },
+    // better-auth only rate-limits when NODE_ENV is production, which the deployment does not set.
+    rateLimit: { enabled: true },
     ...(google && { socialProviders: { google } }),
     databaseHooks: {
       user: { create: { before: requireAllowedNewUser } },
